children: Bowman Consulting Group announced the expiration of its go-shop period with no competing bids and reiterated an all-cash $43.00 per share acquisition by Bernhard expected to close in Q4 2026.
Go-shop period expired Sept 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET with no proposals received.
Bernhard will acquire the company for $43.00 per share in an all-cash transaction.
Transaction implies enterprise value of ~ $1.0 billion and ~58% premium to unaffected Aug 7, 2026 close.
Company solicited 76 parties, entered NDAs with 8; no excluded parties emerged during process.
Merger expected to close Q4 2026, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals and customary conditions.
